configFailure.description: The settings of this server could not be read. Reload the page, and tell your administrator if this continues.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.description: This page could not be shown. Reload it, and tell your administrator if this continues.

mutationFailed.title: The change was not saved

error.credentials: The email address or the password is wrong.
error.invalid: Check your entries and try again.
error.unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Try again in a moment.

rateLimited.unknown: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
rateLimited.seconds: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
rateLimited.minutes: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
